-- The database schema is managed by Alembic migrations:
--
--   api/migrations/versions/   (baseline: 0001_baseline.py)
--
-- Migrations run automatically on every deploy (backend "migrate"
-- initContainer: `alembic upgrade head`). To change the schema:
--
--   cd api && alembic revision -m "describe change"
--
-- then write upgrade()/downgrade() and open a PR. Do not edit this file.
